correctness.rationale: The rational polynomial for W has negative discriminant and the endpoint poles are positive. The rational derivative inequalities certify alternating signs of map derivative at high/low oscillation samples, implying at least 2L-4 genuine turning points. The rational resonance mb=61L makes b an attracting interior fixed point. Integration by parts on compacts and uniform endpoint barrier estimates prove F_L converges uniformly to the published map F_0; the original full-interval published F_0^2 and F_0^6 enclosures force a prime-3 orbit of F_L^2, hence prime 3 or 6 for F_L and positive entropy. Summing the defining equation proves periodic orbit centroids exactly. The nonexplicit entropy threshold is properly qualified.

value.rationale: A fixed analytic convex and steep regularizer class can have arbitrarily high map critical complexity while coexisting local convergence to a stable equilibrium and genuine positive-entropy periodic dynamics. The result separates regularizer curvature oscillations from dynamical coexistence and shows why low-modal 2021 examples do not bound branch complexity. It is an all-L structural realization theorem with a natural game-dynamical motivation, not a routine numerical special case.
